subject: Cloud Computing
title: Edge AI: Intelligence at the Source
description: A quick, practical guide to Edge AI: Intelligence at the Source.

hook.text: Your phone recognizes your face without calling the cloud. That's edge AI — running models locally on the device.

buildup.text: Edge AI uses compressed models (TinyML) that run on chips with minimal power. No internet required for inference.

discovery.text: Training happens in the cloud; inference happens on the edge. The cloud teaches, the device applies what it learned.

twist.text: Privacy improves too. If data never leaves the device, there's nothing to breach. Edge AI keeps your data at home.

climax.text: Apple's Neural Engine, Google's Edge TPU, and NVIDIA Jetson prove that AI at the edge is already mainstream.

punchline.text: AI on your device. No cloud call. Private and instant.

quiz.question: What is a key privacy benefit of edge AI?
options: Data never leaves the device, so there's nothing to breach in transit
Edge AI encrypts all data before sending it to the cloud
Edge AI deletes all data after processing it in the cloud

details.summary: Edge AI runs machine learning inference directly on edge devices or nearby servers, enabling real-time intelligent decisions without cloud round trips. From smartphone face recognition to industrial quality inspection, edge AI brings intelligence to where data is generated.
details.whyItMatters: Edge AI enables intelligent applications in environments where cloud connectivity is unreliable, latency is critical, or data privacy prevents cloud transmission. It expands AI's reach beyond internet-connected settings.
takeaways: ML inference runs directly on edge devices or nearby servers
Real-time decisions happen without cloud connectivity
Privacy-sensitive data stays local instead of leaving the device

faq.question: How is edge AI different from cloud AI?
faq.answer: Cloud AI sends data to powerful remote servers for processing. Edge AI runs smaller, optimized models locally for immediate results. Cloud AI offers more powerful models with higher accuracy. Edge AI offers lower latency and works offline. Many systems use both in combination.

faq.question: What hardware runs edge AI?
faq.answer: NVIDIA Jetson modules, Google Coral TPUs, Apple Neural Engine, and specialized accelerators from Intel and Qualcomm provide AI processing power in small form factors. These chips are optimized for inference rather than training, using minimal power in compact devices.
